title: June brings agent-led implementation to enterprise software
friendlyTitle: June helps companies put AI into real business systems
summary: June has emerged with a platform for mapping business workflows and implementing changes across enterprise systems, data platforms and AI agents. It emphasizes sandbox testing, reviewable changes, audit trails and access to human experts for difficult deployments.
friendlySummary: June maps how a company works, finds places where AI can help and tests changes before they go live.
whyItMatters: The hard part of workplace AI is often integration rather than model capability. A deployment layer that maps existing processes and keeps changes auditable could help companies move from isolated pilots to useful production systems.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Businesses may be able to add useful AI with less risk and less slow manual setup.
